Closing day in Oakville? 4 steps, in order. 1) Days before, sign the final papers with your lawyer and send the balance due. 2) On closing day, your lawyer receives the mortgage funds and registers the transfer. 3) Once the transfer is registered, you legally own the home. 4) Keys follow, usually through the realtors; your agreement sets the time.

Send this to someone closing this year. General information only, not legal advice. Steps and timing vary by deal.
